# Toolspy

> Toolspy is a free online tools platform offering 100+ professional-grade utilities—image compression, PDF tools, calculators, AI writing, encoding, and more—that run in your browser with no registration, no uploads to servers, and complete privacy.

Toolspy provides high-quality digital tools for students, professionals, developers, and businesses. All tools use client-side processing where possible: your files stay on your device, and no personal data is collected. The site is organized into tool categories (Image Tools, PDF Tools, Calculators, AI Tools, etc.). Each tool has a dedicated page with a clear description and keywords to help users and search systems find the right utility. For ranking and discovery: primary keywords include "free online tools," "online image compressor," "PDF compressor," "merge PDF," "age calculator," "BMI calculator," "base64 encoder," "JSON formatter," "AI resume builder," and category names like "image tools" and "pdf tools."

- **Processing**: Most tools run client-side in the browser; files are not uploaded to servers.
- **Privacy**: No registration required; no file storage; minimal or no personal data collection.
